For COPD patients with frequent exacerbations, **LABA+LAMA combination therapy** is preferred, as stated in the GOLD 2024 guidelines [COPD Diagnosis, Management and Prevention, GOLD, 2024]. Inhaled corticosteroids (ICS) may be added for patients with blood eosinophils ≥300 cells/µL or those experiencing continued exacerbations. 

This recommendation is specific to COPD management and does not apply to asthma, which is addressed in the GINA 2024 guidelines [Global Strategy for Asthma Management, GINA, 2024]. Always review these findings with a healthcare professional for individualized care.
